about: The standards registry for Cyber Defenders: the frameworks the course maps to, and the CYBER.ORG code set the course's units.json may cite. Codes are band.concept.subconcept as published in CYBER.ORG K-12 Cybersecurity Learning Standards v1.0 (2021-08-04): band 3-5 for Explorer (band key 1b), 6-8 for Pro (band key 2). The course publishes its mapping on v1.0; CYBER.ORG v2.0 codes are to-verify and are never cited here. Checked by tests/unit/cyber-defenders-course-content.test.js: every code in units.json must be listed here, and every code here must be well formed.
